A '''carapace knitter''' was a type of [[Calcium/Legends|calcium]] paste made by the [[Verpine/Legends|Verpine]] [[Species/Legends|species]] that could be used for healing. Once removed from the tube in which it was kept, the paste would set quickly and could be used as a type of molecular glue to repair broken [[Bone/Legends|bones]] in about five [[Standard minute/Legends|minutes]]. However, the paste was designed for use primarily by [[Insectoid/Legends|insectoids]] and when used by endoskeletal [[Species/Legends|species]], it was required for the paste to be injected directly into the damaged area of the body, which could be an extremely painful experience. In addition, if too much was injected into a damaged [[Limb/Legends|limb]], the overdose could cause the limb to [[Death/Legends|die]].<ref name="BHC" />
